p.title: v59.94 stale snapshot banner stacked a listener pair and a timer on every apply
p.symptom: While market data was over 24 hours old, every snapshot apply added two more live-data listeners and another 45 s fallback timer for the same hide-the-banner job; they piled up for the session while the producer stayed stalled.
p.root_cause: _aioApplySnapshotStaleWarning built a new handler, two { once: true } listeners and a timer on each call, and nothing tracked a set already waiting.
p.fix: One pending set per installed surface: a repeated stale apply keeps the waiting set; the handler, when it hides the banner, removes both listeners, clears the timer and resets the slot; fresh data tears a waiting set down. Listeners are no longer once-only, so an early return on incomplete coverage keeps them waiting.
p.violated_rule: A repeated render path must not register a new subscription per call.
p.prevention: Unit gate installs the surface on a fake window and asserts three stale applies register exactly two listeners and one timer, a live event removes them, and the next stale apply registers a new set.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-esm-core-unit-check.mjs exits 0; with the old data-status-surface.js it fails with 6 listeners and 3 timers after three applies.

changelog: **Stale banner listeners ({P}):** a stale snapshot applied again no longer adds another pair of live-data listeners and another fallback timer; one waiting set hides the banner when live data arrives.
note: v59.94: stale banner keeps one pending listener set
